newsitem.title: JAPAN: Miyakoshi shares gather bids on recent volatility.
newsitem.headline: Miyakoshi shares gather bids on recent volatility.

text.p: Miyakoshi Corp shares were bid-only in mid-morning Tuesday trade as investors returned from a long weekend coveting the shares due to the recent volatility in their price, brokers said.
At 0141 GMT, the shares were bid-only at 650 yen after closing at 600 yen on Friday.
Brokers said bids were accumulating because investors were hoping to profit on short-term price fluctuations.
On Friday afternoon, shares of the audio and video equipment maker added their maximum allowed for a single day, rising 100 yen to 600 yen.
After the market closed on Friday, the Tokyo Stock Exchange said it would announce the outstanding volume of margin trades in the shares, starting with orders placed on September 20.
The exchange sometimes discloses information on margin trade in certain shares that have moved sharply as a precautionary measure for investors.
